title: BBC Learning English from the News 2025 — Quiz 14
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q131_unparalleled
elements.title: No other athlete had achieved anything comparable, so her record was described as ___.

elements.name: q132_damning
elements.title: The audit was ___: it provided compelling evidence of serious failures.

elements.name: q133_bombshell
elements.title: The news that the shop would close tomorrow came as a ___ to staff who expected it to stay open.

elements.name: q134_blow_something_out_the_water
elements.title: The new evidence blew the old theory ___ by showing it could not be true.

elements.name: q135_shed_light_on
elements.title: These letters could ___ what really happened by revealing details nobody knew.

elements.name: q136_gear_up
elements.title: The shop is starting to ___ for the busy holiday season by hiring extra staff.

elements.name: q137_end_game
elements.title: The negotiations have entered the ___, with only the final terms left to settle.

elements.name: q138_split
elements.title: The committee was ___ on the proposal, with members arguing for and against it.

elements.name: q139_on_the_verge_of
elements.title: The glass was ___ breaking when the shelf began to bend.

elements.name: q140_suspend
elements.title: Because of the inspection, the railway will ___ services until further notice.
